title: Action param dialog: an action key for the submit button's verb, falling back to Confirm
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. The order on #27434 said: triage rows 1–7, TAKE what is ui-only, CARD the rest. The card thread measured each row on `origin/main` `e41642dd` (report 6515174308, `out_of_scope_findings`).
Reach: any action with `params`, opened from the record header, a list row's ⋮ menu or the toolbar. HotCRM `send_email`, `log_call`, `log_meeting`.
Reader who acts: `domain:spec` first (the key), then `domain:ui` (the dialog reads it).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "action param dialog submit button label verb instead of Confirm" → only closed cards about the confirm dialog's title and danger variant (#26580, #26781), not this.

## Observed
The param dialog's footer always reads `actionDialog.confirm` ("Confirm"). An action that collects params cannot say its own verb ("Send", "Log Call"). `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` has no such key, and `ActionParamDialog` reads `t('actionDialog.confirm')`.

## Wanted
An optional `I18nLabel` key on `ActionSchema` for the dialog's submit label (translation path `_actions.NAME.KEY`, resolved like `description`). The spec half: the key, the translation-reference lint (`validate-translation-references`) and the docs page. The ui half (a follow-up `domain:ui` card once the key ships): both param-collection handlers pass it, and `ActionParamDialog` draws it, with "Confirm" as the fallback.

Dedupe words: param dialog submit label, actionDialog.confirm, action verb button, confirm button label.

Related: #27434 (row 2).
